tables.name: books

indexes.name: idx_books_uuid
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_books_uuid ON books(uuid)

triggers.name: books_set_updated_at_insert
triggers.def:
CREATE TRIGGER books_set_updated_at_insert
                AFTER INSERT ON books
                FOR EACH ROW
                WHEN NEW.updated_at IS NULL
                BEGIN
                    UPDATE books SET updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = NEW.id;
                END

triggers.name: books_set_updated_at_update
triggers.def:
CREATE TRIGGER books_set_updated_at_update
                AFTER UPDATE ON books
                FOR EACH ROW
                WHEN NEW.updated_at = OLD.updated_at OR NEW.updated_at IS NULL
                BEGIN
                    UPDATE books SET updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = NEW.id;
                END

triggers.name: books_record_tombstone
triggers.def:
CREATE TRIGGER books_record_tombstone
                BEFORE DELETE ON books
                FOR EACH ROW
                WHEN OLD.uuid IS NOT NULL
                BEGIN
                    INSERT INTO sync_tombstones (table_name, uuid) VALUES ('books', OLD.uuid);
                END

tables.def:
CREATE TABLE books (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                title TEXT NOT NULL,
                file_path TEXT NOT NULL,
                file_hash TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
                total_pages INTEGER NOT NULL,
                prompt_overrides TEXT,
                created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            , last_read_at TIMESTAMP, last_read_page INTEGER DEFAULT 1, last_topic_id INTEGER, uuid TEXT, user_id TEXT, updated_at TIMESTAMP, deleted_at TIMESTAMP)

tables.def:
CREATE TABLE topics (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                uuid TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE DEFAULT (
                    lower(hex(randomblob(4))) || '-' ||
                    lower(hex(randomblob(2))) || '-4' ||
                    substr(lower(hex(randomblob(2))), 2) || '-a' ||
                    substr(lower(hex(randomblob(2))), 2) || '-' ||
                    lower(hex(randomblob(6)))
                ),
                book_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                parent_id INTEGER,
                title TEXT NOT NULL,
                level INTEGER NOT NULL,
                start_page INTEGER NOT NULL,
                end_page INTEGER NOT NULL,
                sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL,
                content_md TEXT,
                concept_type TEXT,
                key_terms TEXT,
                atomic_concepts TEXT,
                status TEXT DEFAULT 'unprocessed',
                flashcard_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                breadcrumb TEXT,
                topic_hash TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
                embedding TEXT,
                mastery_score INTEGER,
                mastery_status TEXT DEFAULT 'untested' CHECK (mastery_status IN ('untested', 'mastered', 'developing', 'fragile', 'misconception')),
                last_drilled_at TIMESTAMP,
                created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                updated_at TIMESTAMP,
                user_id TEXT,
                deleted_at TIMESTAMP,
                FOREIGN KEY (book_id) REFERENCES books (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES topics (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
            )

triggers.name: flashcards_count_after_insert
triggers.def:
CREATE TRIGGER flashcards_count_after_insert
            AFTER INSERT ON flashcards
            BEGIN
                UPDATE topics
                SET flashcard_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flashcards WHERE topic_id = NEW.topic_id)
                WHERE id = NEW.topic_id;
            END

triggers.name: flashcards_count_after_delete
triggers.def:
CREATE TRIGGER flashcards_count_after_delete
            AFTER DELETE ON flashcards
            BEGIN
                UPDATE topics
                SET flashcard_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flashcards WHERE topic_id = OLD.topic_id)
                WHERE id = OLD.topic_id;
            END

tables.def:
CREATE TABLE flashcards (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                topic_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                topic_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                concept_type TEXT NOT NULL,
                summary TEXT NOT NULL,
                question TEXT NOT NULL,
                answer TEXT NOT NULL,
                key_terms TEXT NOT NULL,
                code_snippet TEXT,
                image_url TEXT,
                breadcrumb TEXT,
                source_page INTEGER,
                content_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
                created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, state INTEGER DEFAULT 0, stability REAL DEFAULT 0.0, difficulty REAL DEFAULT 0.0, elapsed_days INTEGER DEFAULT 0, scheduled_days INTEGER DEFAULT 0, reps INTEGER DEFAULT 0, lapses INTEGER DEFAULT 0, last_review TEXT, due TEXT, source TEXT DEFAULT 'extraction', origin_attempt_id INTEGER, uuid TEXT, user_id TEXT, updated_at TIMESTAMP, deleted_at TIMESTAMP,
                FOREIGN KEY (topic_id) REFERENCES topics (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                UNIQUE(topic_id, content_hash)
            )

                    last_drilled_at = NEW.evaluated_at
                WHERE id = NEW.topic_id;
            END
